name: 365rwa-rwa-data
description: Read-only RWA (real-world asset tokenization) structured data from 365rwa.vip: project scorecards, issuance archives, licensed-institution registry, full-market token list and regulatory tracker. Free dataset listing; paid per-call verification and queries via x402 (USDC on Base).

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List all RWA datasets with record counts, tools and prices (free)

tools.name: verify_rwa_project
tools.description: Five-level authenticity verdict for a project/token/institution across five databases, with evidence samples

tools.name: query_projects
tools.description: Hand-verified RWA project scorecards: score, TVL, yield, chains, contracts, custodian, auditor, risks

tools.name: query_issuances
tools.description: RWA issuance archives: issuer, underlying asset, amount, regulator, partners, official source

tools.name: query_licenses
tools.description: Global licensed-institution registry across HK/NA/EU/APAC/ME with official registry links

tools.name: query_market
tools.description: Full-market RWA token list: mcap/TVL, 24h change, spot exchanges, three-level risk flag

tools.name: query_regulatory
tools.description: Global regulatory approval tracker from HKMA/SFC/SEC/EBA/BIS/FSA/ESMA/Federal Register
